name: Orbital Floating Bar
author: Charlieras262 (fork: afmpjr)
description: Orbital's floating bar: a fork of charlieras262.floating-bar (MIT) with a floatGapScale option (scale the auto-detected window gap, e.g. 0.5 for half). Full bar replacement: floats over the desktop with rounded corners on whichever edge you place it, gap matching Hyprland's window spacing
